acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic regression reproduces the concurrent read, or the suspicion is closed with evidence.
RequestProgramControl never reports failure for a recorded control.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Suspected defect, not yet reproduced as a regression. internal/tasks/journal/stage_read.go:57: an unlocked journal read can fail MALFORMED: unassigned stage slot while a concurrent writer is staging; only SNAPSHOT_MOVED is retried. Consequence: RequestProgramControl can report a failed drain although the control record was written. Expected: the reader retries the transient state or reads a consistent snapshot, and the control request reports its recorded outcome. Possibly the same root cause as V1-0467 (intermittent unassigned staging slot in concurrent lease qualification); keep distinct until confirmed.
title: Suspected: unlocked journal read fails MALFORMED unassigned stage slot during a concurrent stage, so RequestProgramControl reports a failed drain that was recorded
